budget_limits.name: budget_limits
budget_limits.value: ("budget_settings"."daily_requests" is null or "budget_settings"."daily_requests" >= 0) and ("budget_settings"."concurrency" is null or "budget_settings"."concurrency" >= 0) and ("budget_settings"."daily_audio_seconds" is null or ("budget_settings"."daily_audio_seconds" >= 0 and "budget_settings"."daily_audio_seconds" < 'Infinity'::float8))

chunk_plan_identity.name: chunk_plan_identity
chunk_plan_identity.value: ("content_chunks"."plan_id" is null and "content_chunks"."planner_chunk_id" is null and "content_chunks"."overlap" is null and "content_chunks"."start_seconds" is null and "content_chunks"."end_seconds" is null) or ("content_chunks"."plan_id" is not null and "content_chunks"."planner_chunk_id" is not null and "content_chunks"."planner_chunk_id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "content_chunks"."overlap" is not null and "content_chunks"."overlap" >= 0)

model_role_pair.name: model_role_pair
model_role_pair.value: ("model_roles"."provider" is null and "model_roles"."model" is null or "model_roles"."provider" is not null and "model_roles"."model" is not null and length("model_roles"."provider") > 0 and length("model_roles"."model") > 0) and ("model_roles"."fallback_provider" is null and "model_roles"."fallback_model" is null or "model_roles"."fallback_provider" is not null and "model_roles"."fallback_model" is not null and length("model_roles"."fallback_provider") > 0 and length("model_roles"."fallback_model") > 0) and ("model_roles"."fallback_provider" is null or "model_roles"."provider" is not null)

usage_amounts.name: usage_amounts
usage_amounts.value: ("usage_ledger"."input_tokens" is null or "usage_ledger"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("usage_ledger"."output_tokens" is null or "usage_ledger"."output_tokens" >= 0) and ("usage_ledger"."audio_seconds" is null or ("usage_ledger"."audio_seconds" >= 0 and "usage_ledger"."audio_seconds" < 'Infinity'::float8)) and ("usage_ledger"."cost_usd" is null or ("usage_ledger"."cost_usd" >= 0 and "usage_ledger"."cost_usd" < 'Infinity'::float8))

usage_owner_tuple.name: usage_owner_tuple
usage_owner_tuple.value: ("usage_ledger"."owner_token" is null and "usage_ledger"."owner_pid" is null and "usage_ledger"."owner_backend_start" is null) or ("usage_ledger"."owner_token" is not null and "usage_ledger"."owner_pid" is not null and "usage_ledger"."owner_pid" > 0 and "usage_ledger"."owner_backend_start" is not null)

usage_reserved_owner.name: usage_reserved_owner
usage_reserved_owner.value: "usage_ledger"."status" <> 'reserved' or ("usage_ledger"."owner_token" is not null and "usage_ledger"."owner_pid" is not null and "usage_ledger"."owner_backend_start" is not null and "usage_ledger"."settled_at" is null)
